title: Application crushes on Android 16
body:
Hi,

I’m used to downloading the code in “.zip” format and creating a new APK in fullRelease mode for my current phone running Android 14, version 3.3.1.2.
I need to switch smartphone, and when I try to do the same thing on my new phone running Android 16, Android Studio generates the APK as usual, but when I try to install the app on the new phone, it opens and then closes immediately on its own.

I’ve tried a few solutions, such as:
- Installing the new AAPS
- Granting all permissions (location, Bluetooth, no battery saver mode/restrictions)
- Opening the app

But the result is always the same.
Does anyone have any suggestions for me?

comments.body: old versions are not supported. upgrade first

Hi Milos, ofc I download the last version available (3.4.2.3) when I try to install it on Android 16.
The version 3.3.1.2 is the old installed on Android 14.
